failures.root_cause: Test suite's TMPDIR (/tmp/claude) doesn't exist on the runner, so mktemp fails to create the sw-test-XXXXXX temp dir, cascading into a sed failure on the missing $TEST_TEMP_DIR path
failures.fix: Create /tmp/claude (mkdir -p) before test setup or unset/reset TMPDIR to a guaranteed-writable path in the test harness bootstrap
